title: Tekken 3, expanded
intro: Tekken 3 Expanded brings Tekken Tag Tournament's cast, stages and music into Tekken 3. It is built on your PC from your own discs and ROMs; the hub only runs the build.

chapters.title: Your games, your build
chapters.body: Point the hub at your Tekken 3 PlayStation disc and the Tekken Tag Tournament arcade ROM. Tekken 3 arcade, TTT on PS2 and Tekken 5 DR are optional extras that add more.

chapters.title: Eighteen new fighters
chapters.body: The Tekken Tag Tournament characters join the select screen, and Tekken 3's own cast gets their TTT movesets and models.

chapters.title: Stages and music
chapters.body: Tekken Tag Tournament's and Tekken 3 arcade's stages come with their music, alongside the originals.

chapters.title: Endings and Jin's DR moveset
chapters.body: TTT's endings play in the game's own engine, and with Tekken 5 DR set up, Jin can fight with his Dark Resurrection moves.

chapters.title: Changed something? Build again
chapters.body: When you add a game file or an add-on such as TMST, click Build again on the project page so the game picks it up.
